title: docs: "a virtual object — rows from your server, shown in any view": plugin-driver recipe, five business examples, the three-way rule, driver shape-pin test; the #27130 customer reply (epic #27261 P1)
body:
Blocked-by: #27276

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6471382887 on #27261 (batch #423, maintainer 「立专题卡」 2026-10-28): the ontology-over-external-systems epic opens with Tier A (plugin driver, zero protocol change). Part of #27261. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade. Design: #27261 body; the first customer pull: #27130 (route d, design 6468011868).

Ruling-ref: 6471382887

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 指南：虚拟对象的完整配方（数据源、外部绑定对象、`current_user` 公式锁、`beforeUpdate` hook、视图）+ driver 骨架 + 五个业务例（港口排程、SAP 订单、HR 目录、设备实时状态、反例：慢变参考数据用真对象 + DataSync）+ 三分法 + driver 形状 pin 测试模板。
- **为什么改：** 这是回复 #27130 客户的配方，也是 AI 作者照抄的样板。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯文档；配方以 P0 的测试为可执行示例。
- **先看：** `content/docs/`（数据建模 / 集成）；P0 测试文件。
- **两分钟验证：** docs-audit 通过；按配方在本地跑通 P0 测试的例子。
- **需要您做的：** 文档落地后由分诊席在 #27130 线程用席位的话回复客户（不复述其指令形文字）。

## Task

- [ ] Write the guide from the P0 test; the three-way rule (computed / must-not-land / real-time ⇒ virtual; slow reference data ⇒ real object + DataSync).
- [ ] Driver skeleton and the shape-pin test template.
- [ ] docs-audit affected-docs green.

`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Size S. Lane: devx.

Epic: #27261 (parent; the epic PM dispatches `pm:epic` children). Dedupe: #27261, #27130, ADR-0015; no open card carries this slice.
